text:
yuki: heads-up: apac-sin region is seeing a simultaneous spot reclaim on mixed pools since 04:07 SGT, lots of T4 and A100 preempts. p95 for 70B jumps ~200ms.

ops-bot: ALERT: spot-reclaim-wave detected in apac-sin at 2026-04-01T04:07:48Z — preemptions: 58 in 6m — severity: high

noah: which pools? prod-mixed-apac and burstable-spot-apac? any reserved-only pools affected?

cam: prod-mixed-apac and lowcost-bursters affected. KV cache churn causing token generation stalls on long sessions.

priya: current routing is local_spot -> local_ondemand -> crossregion_sync -> crossregion_async. That sync step is causing head-of-line blocking when local ondemand spinups are slow.

andre: proposal: change failover sequencing under high eviction rate to: (1) paid customers: reserve local ondemand slots (fast lane) and parallel async fanout to apac-north for cold fallback; (2) free/trial: immediate quantized-variant fallback with short-context cap; (3) all: backoff weighted fanout for cross-region to limit cloud API spikes.

yuki: add quality guard: only allow quantized fallback if model_eval_drop_pct <= 6%. otherwise prefer async crossregion for critical queries.

noah: suggest weights example to smooth: paid {ondemand_local:0.85, crossregion_async:0.15}, free {quantized_local:0.6, crossregion_async:0.4}. This reduces simultaneous ondemand spinups.

cam: also: implement a short-lived spinup lease token per control-loop so multiple controllers don't start ondemand for the same placement group at once.

priya: autoscaler tweak: maintain ondemand_headroom +10% for 3m after eviction_wave, but only for clusters with >20% spot mix to limit cost.

andre: cost check: expected delta if we shift 25% of spot->ondemand for 12h: +$4.5k. If we push 40% of free traffic to quantized variants: -$1.8k. Acceptable for emergency window.

ops-bot: Note: changing autoscaler headroom requires canary. Recommended canary in az-apac-sin-b for 15m with 2m reporting intervals.

yuki: raj/sre: can we start canary now? gate: eviction_rate, p95/p99, and model_quality_regressions for top prompts.

noah: starting canary. will tag telemetry by customer_tier and route_path.

ops-bot: Canary started 2026-04-01T04:12:00Z in az-apac-sin-b. reporting_interval: 2m

cam: quick config snippet to apply (will ship behind toggle):
```
routing:
  eviction_threshold: 0.035
  ondemand_headroom: 0.10
  headroom_duration: 180s
  customer_weights:
    paid: {ondemand_local:0.85, crossregion_async:0.15}
    free: {quantized_local:0.6, crossregion_async:0.4}
  quantized_quality_cap: 0.06
  spinup_lease_ttl: 30s
```

priya: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/193 — includes sim harness with weighted fanout and lease token tests.

ops-bot: Canary metrics (first 6m): eviction_rate 0.048 -> 0.013 after headroom + weighted routing. p99 reduced by ~130ms for paid lanes. model_quality_regressions for quantized fallbacks: median drop 3.8% (within cap).

yuki: good. keep canary full 15m. if stable, stage rollout across other apac AZs with 3m staggers.

andre: add runbook step: quick-kill: set routing.toggle=off -> immediate revert to pre-policy routing and drain new ondemand instances.

noah: also: schedule postmortem with cost table and customer-impact slices. I'll instrument a nightly job to aggregate termination-notice patterns for apac for the last 30 days.

yuki: action items:
- noah: monitor canary and post staged rollout timeline
- priya: merge PR and ensure feature-flag toggle + rollback
- cam: add spinup lease implementation + unit tests
- andre: draft cost-impact appendix for execs

ops-bot: Canary completed: stable for 15m. commencing staged rollout.

yuki: thanks team — sync tomorrow 08:00 SGT to review full rollout metrics and decide permanent defaults for apac mixed pools.
